title: 第20章 入道第21章 出发
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
凌宇深知，要想在修炼的道路上达到出神入化之境，就必须对自己的功法和术法有着独到的见解和深刻的理解。
就像大家都在“烧开水”，但有的人却利用这个原理对蒸汽机进行了优化与改进，使之更加高效，这就是对技艺的深刻洞察和创新，这就是出神入化之境。
至于以后的分离式冷凝器、活塞和气缸的设计，每个里面都完美的利用了“烧开水”这个原理。
虽然看似与烧开水无关，但实际上却处处蕴含着其原理，这是一种对基础原理的深入理解和应用。
这就是返璞归真之境，虽未见“烧开水”之形，但处处含有其理。
整合自己所掌握的所有功法，这不仅是对自己实力的一次提升，更是对自己修炼道路的一次深刻反思。
时常“三省己身”，审视自己的能力和技能，这样的自省让他更加清晰地认识到自己的长处和不足。
所以我们要经常“三省吾身”，仔细想想我们会什么，这么一想你会发觉自己也不是什么都不会，还是有可取之处的。
特别是对于修炼者来说，自省尤为重要。
要知道，在关键时刻，忘记自己掌握的技能，可能会导致严重的后果。
就像有的人平时看似什么都会，但一到关键时刻，却因为紧张而大脑一片空白，这无疑是修炼者的大忌。
凌宇停止了胡思乱想，平复了一下心境，打算先将自己的修为提升上去，毕竟实力才是一切的根本。
入道境便是感悟到洞天真意，以洞天之力驾驭、收摄天地灵力，从而提高术法威力等。
最明显的是从此可以自由地翱翔天际了，而不像“轻身术”一样只是短距离飞行或者腾挪，长远距离追赶还需要频繁借力一样。
每一个座洞天都有不同的意境，这是一个修行者精气神的完美呈现。
比如五行洞天，是最适合种植的洞天之一，而且能够加强五行法术的威力等。
还有的洞天具有辅助修行的效果，有的可以加快修行速度，有的可以增添感悟。
洞天的功能千奇百怪，每一个都独一无二。
只有相似的洞天，而没有完全相同的两个洞天。
在辅助洞天的悟性加持之下，凌宇神清志明，思维愈发清晰，体内洞天的一切都如掌上观纹，清晰可见。

步入入道境之过程实非易事，凌宇内心却波澜不惊。
凝心静气，将全部精力集中于修炼之上，调整呼吸，使心境如平静湖面，不起波澜。
缓缓地将身躯渐渐放松，感官却变得异常敏锐。
能感受到周遭空气之流动，仿若与大自然相融。
思绪缓缓深入洞天之中，仿若置身于神秘美妙的世界。
于此世界中，见五彩斑斓之光芒，闻悠扬悦耳之声。
凌宇小心翼翼探索着未知领域，用心感受其中的奥秘。
content_en:
Ling Yu knew very well that if he wanted to reach a state of perfection on the road of cultivation, he must have unique insights and a deep understanding of his own skills and techniques.
Just like everyone is "boiling water", but some people use this principle to optimize and improve the steam engine to make it more efficient. This is a profound insight and innovation into the craft, and this is a state of perfection.
As for the future designs of separate condensers, pistons and cylinders, each of them perfectly utilizes the principle of "boiling water".
Although it seems to have nothing to do with boiling water, it actually contains its principles everywhere. This is an in-depth understanding and application of basic principles.
This is the state of returning to nature. Although there is no "boiling water" shape, there are principles everywhere.
Integrating all the techniques you have mastered is not only an improvement in your own strength, but also a profound reflection on your own cultivation path.
He often "examines himself three times" and examines his abilities and skills. Such self-examination allows him to more clearly understand his strengths and weaknesses.
Therefore, we must always "examine ourselves" and think carefully about what we know. When you think about it, you will find that you are not know nothing, and you still have merits.
Especially for practitioners, self-examination is particularly important.
You know, forgetting the skills you have mastered at critical moments may lead to serious consequences.
Just like some people who seem to know everything at ordinary times, but at critical moments, their minds go blank due to nervousness. This is undoubtedly a taboo for practitioners.
Ling Yu stopped thinking, calmed down, and planned to improve his cultivation first. After all, strength is the foundation of everything.
Entering the Taoist realm means realizing the inner meaning of the cave, using the power of the cave to control and absorb the spiritual power of heaven and earth, thereby increasing the power of spells, etc.
The most obvious thing is that you can fly freely in the sky from now on, unlike the "Light Body Technique" where you can only fly or move in short distances, and you need to frequently use force to catch up over long distances.
Each cave has a different artistic conception, which is a perfect presentation of the spirit and spirit of a practitioner.
For example, the Five Elements Cave is one of the most suitable caves for planting, and it can enhance the power of Five Elements spells.
There are also caves that have the effect of assisting practice, some can speed up practice, and some can increase enlightenment.
The functions of the cave are all kinds of strange, and each one is unique.
There are only similar caves, but there are no two identical caves.
With the help of Dongtian's understanding and blessing, Ling Yu became clear and clear, and his thinking became clearer. Everything in Dongtian in his body was clearly visible like lines on the palm of his hand.
The process of entering the Taoist realm is not easy, but Ling Yu's heart is calm.
Concentrate your mind and calm your breath, focus all your energy on cultivation, and adjust your breathing so that your state of mind is like a calm lake, without any ripples.
Slowly relaxing your body, your senses become extremely sharp.
You can feel the flow of air around you, as if you are in harmony with nature.
My thoughts slowly went deep into the cave, as if I was in a mysterious and wonderful world.
In this world, you can see colorful lights and hear melodious sounds.
Ling Yu carefully explored the unknown territory and felt its mysteries with his heart.
